Name: Bye-Bye Tutorial-Senpai
Author: DespairScent
Description:
Is it [b]frustrating[/b] to see a tutorial every time you start a new farm? Do you feel like the game treats you, [b]BiG pRO[/b], like a [u][i]smoll NOOB[/i][/u]?

Then this mod will definitely cure your [s]shattered[/s] self-esteem. No more tutorials on how to move and use tools.
As a bonus, we also removed the tutorial during your [not really] first fishing to make you feel even better!


Check out my other mods: [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/DespairScent/mods?gameId=1303]click![/url]

Source code: [url=https://github.com/DespairScent-SDV/ByeByeTutorialSenpai]GitHub[/url]
